name: candidate-final-audit
cmd: bun test audit-input/audit.test.ts && bun audit-input/audit.ts audit-result audit-input/smoke audit-input/census

name: candidate-commitlint
cmd: set -euo pipefail; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional >/dev/null); printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs"; for file in message-input/messages/*.txt; do sha256sum "$file"; "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < "$file"; done
